info.title: API.SH: Made-in-China
info.description: The Made-in-China API from API.SH: public Made-in-China data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Made-in-China.com's search-box keyword suggestions: each keyword with its result count, the category it names (when it is a category suggestion) and the related keywords the site offers with it. `kind=suppliers` gives the supplier-search suggestions instead.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/made-in-china-autocomplete

parameters.description: Start of a search.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Product (default) or supplier search suggestions.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products listed in a Made-in-China.com category: name, link, images, price text with min and max (USD), unit, minimum order, summary, secured-trading and video flags, and supplier (name, site, id, audited flag, rating, label, location). Also the category's name, code (usable as `category` in /made-in-china/v1/search), level, result count, breadcrumbs, subcategories with counts, and the site's filters (material, style, feature...) with counts, each a link to pass back as `url` for the filtered listings. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/made-in-china-category

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A category page (https://www.made-in-china.com/<Group>-Catalog/<Name>.html, from `subcategories` or the site's category directory), or a filter link from `filters`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Pass the product `url`, or `q` to open the first product a search finds.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/made-in-china-product

get.description:
Products on Made-in-China.com matching a keyword, with the site's filters: supplier business type, R&D capacity, audited suppliers, secured trading, leading factories, samples available, price range (US$), maximum minimum order, product category and product properties (codes from `facets`). Each product has id, name, link, image, price text with min and max (USD), price type (FOB), minimum order, key properties, certifications, secured-trading flag and supplier (name, site, id, membership level, audited flag, location, business type, capability stars). `facets` lists every filter value the site offers for the query. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/made-in-china-search

get.description:
One supplier's Made-in-China.com company profile: name, site, business type, main products, address, plant area, registered capital, main markets, rating, membership level and since when, audited flag and audit report number, all general, trade capacity and R&D facts (incoterms, payment terms, lead times, export year, nearest port, engineers, machines...), the most used of these also as top-level fields (`payment_terms`, `incoterms`, `lead_time`, `nearest_port`, `export_year`, `management_certification`), `certifications` (the certificate titles it shows), company introduction and the company show (workshop, certificates, exhibitions). No personal contact names. Pass the supplier site `url`, or `q` to open the first supplier a search finds.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/made-in-china-supplier

get.description:
A Made-in-China.com supplier's showroom catalog, 24 a page: product id, name, link, price text and range, currency, unit, price type (FOB...), minimum order, the listed specifications, video and secured-trading flags, and images; plus the total, the page count and the supplier's product groups (pass one as `group`). List all products, one group, or a keyword search inside the showroom (`q`). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/made-in-china-supplier-products

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The supplier: <name>.en.made-in-china.com in any form (any page on it, a showroom or product-group link), or the <name> alone.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Product group from `groups`, e.g. Ball-Valve (or its link).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords to search inside the showroom.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Suppliers on Made-in-China.com matching a keyword: id, name, supplier site, business type, main products, management certification, city and province, audited flag, capability stars, capabilities (ODM, OEM, own brand) and sample products with links. Filter by audited status, business type, province and city, industry, management certification, annual revenue and staff size; `filters` lists every value with its count for the current results (pass a `value` back as that param), `applied_filters` echoes the filters in effect. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/made-in-china-suppliers

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Product or company keyword.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1 by default).

parameters.name: audited
parameters.description: true: only audited suppliers (reviewed by an inspection service).

parameters.name: business_type
parameters.description: manufacturer, trading_company, group_corporation, individual or other (or a value from `filters.business_type`).

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Province or region, a value from `filters.province` (e.g. Guangdong, Zhejiang, Hongkong, Taiwan).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City, a value from `filters.city` (listed once a province is set, e.g. Guangdong_Shenzhen).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Industry, a value from `filters.category` (e.g. Arts-Crafts-Catalog).

parameters.name: certification
parameters.description: Management certification id from `filters.certification` (e.g. 10 = ISO 9001, 20 = BSCI).

parameters.name: revenue
parameters.description: Annual revenue band id from `filters.revenue` (e.g. 2 = 1-2.5 million USD, 7 = over 100 million USD).

parameters.name: employees
parameters.description: Staff size band id from `filters.employees` (e.g. 2 = 5-50 people, 4 = 201-500 people).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
